note: Missouri River bottomland wetlands and a restored river chute north of Corning. The one camping spot MDC maps is beside the gravel parking lot at the south end of Golden Avenue, on the river side of the levee. Spot length is not published. --Claude

MDC posts no area map (the page's 'Area Map' link is an older brochure); GIS has one camping point (1042) at the gravel lot (1052) ending Golden Ave. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin fine. Not waterfront kept (river ~550 m W). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. Brochure (11/2025): 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map. Camping is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period... Motor vehicles are allowed only on graveled public roadways and parking areas unless otherwise posted.' MDC's page links no actual area map (its 'Area Map' file is the 02/2025 brochure), so the GIS layer is the only map: one Primitive Camping Area point (1042), 25 m SW of a gravel lot (1052) at the end of the gravel road. Imagery: an open gravel apron ~40 x 30 m with the road continuing south; a 23-ft rig fits. No ford, 4WD or rig wording. Single spot, so no clusters.
